rival_hypotheses.H1: independently enacted A practice extends to later comparable opportunity after peer absent; alternative role compliance
rival_hypotheses.H2: independent B act and relation alter A's options under matched material opportunity; alternative mere co-presence or B acting instead
rival_hypotheses.H3: context-specific contrary commitments persist, no required synthesis or mature narrative; alternative measurement difference
rival_hypotheses.H0: structural position/fixture, opportunity and task selection suffice; no acquired A practice
